register.labelZh: LEVEL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: level off 和 level out 可以表示銷量、價格、增長或其他數字不再上升或下降。；你可以使用 LEVEL 片語動詞描述道路變得平坦、飛機轉為水平飛行,或有人把地面弄平。；level something up 表示提高較低的水平;level something down 則表示降低較高的水平來達致一致。；level criticism at someone 可以描述公開批評;level with someone 則適合用來表示坦白而直接地說話。
register.summaryEn: Level off and level out allow you to explain that sales, prices, growth or other figures are no longer rising or falling. You can use LEVEL expressions when a road becomes flat, an aircraft begins flying horizontally or someone makes the ground smooth. Level something up describes improving a lower standard, while level something down describes creating equality by lowering a higher standard. Level criticism at someone describes public criticism. Level with someone is useful when you need to speak honestly and directly.
